# Particle

[Toolkit](README.md) · `DotGame.Toolkit.Particles` · struct

```csharp
public struct Particle
```

A particle's simulation state, as a custom [`IParticleBehavior`](IParticleBehavior.md) sees and adjusts it.

## Remarks

Values that change over the particle's life (its scale, opacity, and color curves, its spin, sway, and flip) are computed from its age when drawn, so these hold their starting values. Times are in seconds.
